subject.title: fix(sqlite): keep additive agent schema at version 11

question: Should this land before the next release while intentionally requiring manual recovery for databases touched by the transient version-12 main build?
rationale: The code path is correct for shipped version-11 databases, but landing it deliberately makes transient current-main version-12 databases newer than the supported marker and therefore requires maintainer acceptance of that narrow operator impact.

options.title: Land before release
options.body: Merge the focused correction, accept the unshipped-main compatibility boundary, and publish precise backup-and-marker recovery instructions for affected developers.

options.title: Add automated recovery
options.body: Pause and add a narrowly scoped doctor repair only if maintainers want the unreleased version-12 state supported automatically.

recommendation.title: Land before release
recommendation.body: Merge the focused correction, accept the unshipped-main compatibility boundary, and publish precise backup-and-marker recovery instructions for affected developers.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author supplied the version-consolidation rationale and is the strongest available owner for accepting the transient-main recovery boundary.
